description: This Java class implements functionality to convert an OutboundSignal.Mapped into an ExternalMessage with optional header mappings applied. It applies header mappings that may contain placeholders by resolving them before adding as headers to the message.

classes.name: OutboundSignalToExternalMessage
classes.description: An immutable class implementing Supplier<ExternalMessage> that converts an OutboundSignal.Mapped into an ExternalMessage, applying optional header mappings with placeholder resolution.

methods.name: OutboundSignalToExternalMessage
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the object with the OutboundSignal, expression resolver, and header mapping.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new OutboundSignalToExternalMessage instance, handling null header mapping.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns an ExternalMessage, applying header mappings if they are present.

methods.name: mapHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new header map by resolving placeholders in header values.

methods.name: mapHeaderByResolver
methods.description: Resolves a header value placeholder using the expression resolver, returning an Optional<String>.
